galway_boutique_keeper.text: Ah, hello there! Come in out of that. We've jumpers that outlast the weather and the weather's had a very long run.

then.text: That {worn_coat} looks grand, so it does. Salthill would not stand a chance against it.
The {worn_hat}: lovely. You'd pass for a local, if you walked a bit slower.
A fine {worn_top}. Now there's an Aran that would make it blush.
That {worn_neck} sits well on you. A good thing at your throat saves a lot of grumbling.
And those {worn_shoes}: you can tell a lot from a person's feet. Good things.

else.text: You're not wearing much that'd keep the wind out. Let's sort that.

galway_boutique_keeper.text: Come back when you want something else. We don't close, we just get sleepier.
